says: In next/, the tuval override replaces next/**'s import bans but leaves out the exam/plant.ts ban (CI paths law 20), so a tuval file may import the plant helper.
proof: Scratch files importing apps/fabrika/src/exam/plant.ts, linted with `pnpm exec oxlint -c .oxlintrc.json`: next/programs/counter/src/zzprobe.ts got 'error eslint(no-restricted-imports) ... CI paths, law 20'; next/packages/tuval/src/window/zzprobe.ts got no import error. Files removed afterwards.
cost: A tuval test could read the plant helper without being on changes.mjs's reader list, so a comment-only change to it would skip that test in CI.
